QuestInfo.name: [Chu Chu] Great and Terrible Taste
QuestInfo.0: Prepare your tastebuds for the ultimate culinary experience, courtesy of Top Chef Master Lyck!
QuestInfo.1: Prepare your tastebuds for the ultimate culinary experience, courtesy of Top Chef Master Lyck!
QuestInfo.2: You ate the special dish prepared by Top Chef Master Lyck, and it was... not the best. Master Lyck was deeply offended that you didn't find it incredible, and tore into your sandwich seemingly out of revenge. Now you've been challenged to a culinary battle before Gulla is expected to attack.
